claim_boundary: This study reuses the already-observed 18-page OmniDocBench demo evidence from the August 1 parser evaluation. It is development calibration only. It is not fresh confirmatory evidence, a field SLO, a production threshold selection study, a customer-data benchmark, or patent novelty evidence.

custom_page_metric.description: Deterministic page-level development damage built from normalized semantic-content sequence disagreement, exact critical-token preservation, GT table-token recall, GT formula-sequence agreement, and ordered semantic-content agreement. It is used only to compare parser/routing behavior within this 18-page development cohort.

deployment_feature_discipline.strong_disagreement_proxy: Paddle-vs-MinerU disagreement is reported separately as a counterfactual signal. It is not treated as free/deployment-available because obtaining it already requires the strong parser on this cohort.

threshold_selection_rule: No production threshold is selected from this 18-page cohort. Results may identify only a candidate calibration region and failure modes for the next fresh frozen confirmatory study.
